description: Checks image files on this machine (absolute paths) against a store's rules, from each file's own header: PNG or JPEG, no transparency, the size (Apple: exactly one of the device size's; Google Play: 320 to 3840 px a side, at most twice as long as wide; the feature graphic exactly 1024×500) and the file size. With type, against that device type, and says if there are more files than a set holds; without it, which of the store's types take each file as it is. Nothing is sent anywhere.

type.description: Apple's display type (APP_IPHONE_67, APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129…) or Google Play's image type (phoneScreenshots, sevenInchScreenshots, tenInchScreenshots, featureGraphic; a Wear OS app's wearScreenshots, a TV app's tvScreenshots and tvBanner).

name: ploa_screenshot_check
title: Check screenshots before uploading
